content.text: In Ghana, digital creators face a stark reality: global [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually|Payment Options]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or unreliable. This leaves you unable to collect payments for your ebooks, courses, or templates. The problem isn’t just about access—it’s about [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]]ty. Every platform you’ve tried either rejects your transactions or imposes conditions that strip you of control. COREMERCH solves this with the Edge Commerce Stack, a fully deployable infrastructure that gives you ownership over your payment processing, product delivery, and customer data. Built on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital|cloudflare]], Supabase, and blockchain-based payments, it’s designed to work where others fail. This isn’t a workaround—it’s a permanent solution.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-what-nobody-tells-you. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: The Full List With Context

1. **Blockchain-Based Payments**: NOWPayments integrates 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. Payments confirm on-chain instantly, bypassing geographic restrictions. 2. **Cloudflare Infrastructure**: Cloudflare Pages hosts your store, Workers handle backend logic, and R2 delivers files—all globally distributed and free. 3. **Supabase for Order Storage**: A scalable, open-source database that stores order data securely without third-party dependencies. 4. **SPF/DKIM/DMARC Configuration**: Ensures your transactional emails (order confirmations, delivery links) reach customers without landing in spam. 5. **End-to-End Testing**: Every deployment is tested for payment confirmation, file delivery, and email delivery before handover.
Why Each Item on This List Matters

Blockchain payments remove the need for intermediaries like banks or payment processors, which often block transactions in Ghana. Cloudflare’s infrastructure ensures your store loads fast and reliably, even during local network disruptions. Supabase gives you full ownership of your customer data, eliminating the risk of platform lock-in. Email deliverability is critical—without SPF/DKIM/DMARC, your customers might never receive their purchase links. End-to-end testing guarantees your stack works flawlessly from payment to delivery, so you don’t lose sales due to technical failures.
The Ones Most Creators Get Wrong

Most creators try to patch together free tools without understanding how they integrate. For example, using Google Drive for file delivery without proper backend logic results in broken links. Relying on personal email accounts for order confirmations leads to spam flags. Attempting to accept crypto payments without automatic on-chain verification causes delays and disputes. These mistakes cost time and revenue. The Edge Commerce Stack eliminates these errors by deploying a pre-tested, integrated system.
Blockchain payments remove geographic barriers entirely.
How to Prioritise What to Implement First

Start with payment processing—without it, nothing else matters. NOWPayments is the foundation. Next, deploy Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Workers for backend logic to ensure your store is live and functional. Then, integrate Supabase for order storage to track transactions securely. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC to ensure email deliverability. Finally, load your products and test the entire flow. The Edge Commerce Stack handles this prioritization for you, deploying everything in 48 hours.
Putting the List Into a Deployable Stack

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) combines all five components into a single deployment. It’s not a tutorial—it’s a fully operational store handed over to you. You get Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, NOWPayments for crypto processing, and R2 for file delivery. SPF/DKIM/DMARC is pre-configured, and the entire stack is end-to-end tested. You own everything after deployment—no subscriptions, no dependencies. It’s infrastructure sovereignty, built for creators in Ghana who refuse to be locked out.

Creators in Ghana can get paid online reliably by deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, which uses blockchain-based payments, Cloudflare infrastructure, and secure order storage. This stack bypasses geographic restrictions, ensures fast and reliable transactions, and gives you full ownership of your store. It’s designed to work where platforms like Stripe and PayPal fail, providing a permanent solution for digital creators.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. **Choose Your Payment Network**: Use BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees under $0.10. 2. **Deploy Cloudflare Pages**: Host your store on a globally distributed network. 3. **Set Up Supabase**: Configure your database for secure order storage. 4. **Integrate NOWPayments**: Enable automatic on-chain payment verification. 5. **Configure Email Deliverability**: Set up SPF/DKIM/DMARC for your domain. 6. **Test the Entire Flow**: Ensure payments, file delivery, and emails work seamlessly. 7. **Load Your Products**: Add up to 5 products to your store. 8. **Take Ownership**: After deployment, COREMERCH has no access—it’s yours.

Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack is deployed for you. You get a fully operational store without needing to write code.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay monthly fees?
No. The stack uses free tools like Cloudflare Pages and Supabase. The only fee is NOWPayments’ 0.5% per transaction.
What happens after deployment?
You own everything—the code, the data, the infrastructure. COREMERCH has no access, and you have lifetime control.
How long does deployment take?
